name: Jones Creek Apparel
old_description: Since 2010, Jones Creek Apparel has been Central Iowa's trusted partner for custom apparel — built on honest pricing, in-house production, and the kind of personal service that other vendors simply don't offer.
about:
Jones Creek Apparel opened in 2010 in Winterset, Iowa, with a commitment to provide custom apparel backed by personal service that larger vendors could not match. The company operates from its own facility at 124 West Jefferson Street and also serves the Des Moines metro through a sub-brand, Waukee Ink.

The shop produces screen printing, embroidery, and direct-to-film (DTF) printing entirely in-house, while sublimated jerseys and promotional products are sourced through trusted partners but held to the same quality standard. The company decorates garments from brands such as Nike, Under Armour, New Era, and Gildan, and states it handles orders ranging from six pieces to 600 pieces with the same attention.

Clients include businesses, schools, sports teams, and organizations across Central Iowa. Examples cited by the company include Farmers & Merchants State Bank and various local teams and small businesses seeking corporate uniforms, team apparel, event giveaways, and corporate gifts.

Jones Creek Apparel emphasizes honest pricing with no setup fees, complimentary graphic design, and a transparent process from garment selection to final proof. The company says its differentiator is consistent, hands-on care regardless of order size, delivered by the same team that produces the work.
